name: qbeta-published-form-is-the-inadmissible-z1
description: The framework's published Q_beta closed form m_e|q^2-2q-1|(q+1)/(2q^3) is EXACTLY |tr_M(Delta_S)| * E0 evaluated at Markov parameter z = 1 -- the coordinate sum epsNPq. Solving for z gives z = 1 (positive branch) and z = h - 1 (negative), and neither is a root of the (1^3) weight numerator, whose only roots are z = q and z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) (ConventionDAdmissibleRoots.lean, sorry-free). So the published form commits to the one functional convention D forbids. Scope-(a) on the physics; the inadmissibility is scope-(b) with the root computation as the cited invariant. Nothing wired.

assertions.name: published_closed_form_equals_abs_epsNPq_times_E0
assertions.detail: simplify(|epsNPq|*E0 - published) = 0 on 1 < q < 1+sqrt(2) (exact over Q(q), not a numerical coincidence)

assertions.name: identity_also_holds_above_the_silver_ratio
assertions.detail: same difference with both signs flipped = 0 (so the identity is not an artifact of the branch chosen)

assertions.name: the_pin_lies_below_the_silver_ratio
assertions.detail: q0 = 1.1099785827... < 1+sqrt(2) = 2.41421..., so the first branch is the physical one

assertions.name: solved_z_one_is_NOT_an_admissible_root
assertions.detail: N(q, one) = -(q - 1)*(-q**3 + q**2 + 1) (nonzero as a polynomial in q)

assertions.name: solved_z_h_minus_one_is_NOT_an_admissible_root
assertions.detail: N(q, h_minus_one) = (q + 1)*(q**3 + q + 1)/q**2 (nonzero as a polynomial in q)

assertions.name: the_plastic_number_is_a_DIFFERENT_constant
assertions.detail: plastic (root of q^3-q-1) = 1.32471795724 != 1.46557123188; it does NOT annihilate N(q,1). The corpus calls the bound 'plastic' in 4 sites; the value it quotes (1.4656) is the supergolden one and is correct.

assertions.name: the_pin_is_below_the_bound
assertions.detail: q0 = 1.10997858275 < 1.46557123188, so z = 1 is genuinely not a root AT the substrate, not merely generically

assertions.name: reproduces_the_corpus_published_grid
assertions.detail: max |mine - audit 2026-08-29| = 0.0002431 pp over the three cells (calibration, not a new result)

caveats: Does NOT show the published Q_beta value is wrong as arithmetic; it is exact and reproduces to 50 digits.
Does NOT adjudicate which functional SHOULD be used -- that is the owner call qou-99qc holds open. It removes the ambiguity about which one the PUBLISHED form uses.
The grid row values are a calibration against docs/audits/2026-08-29-delta-fork-at-admissible-parameters.md, not new measurements.
Delta_S (the NF vector) only. qou-avt5's standing finding that Delta_S is not the exhibited nucleon-word difference is untouched; the Delta_L row of the grid is unaffected by this.
q0AnchorReason: Readout only. Every algebraic result (the z solve, the root computation, the two identities) is exact over Q(q) and pin-free; q0 enters solely to print the err_pct grid at the canonical experimental pin.
